items.reason: The Lift field flows from preset decoding into dashboard row lifting.
Only the shipped active preset enables Lift.
pin silently decodes into Lift; tests assert no warnings or findings.
Decoding lift after pin gives lift precedence.
An omitted grant defaults to false.
Invalid types produce nonfatal preset findings for either spelling.
Derived-ordering identifiers, comments and test filenames use lift; alias references remain explicit.
The unrelated pin behaviors and terminology remain unchanged.
The field metadata and shipped presets use lift; pin remains a read alias.
Launch resolves sibling worktrees to their shared repository identity.
Checkout attribution retains its ranking and returns before repository attribution.
Task-set tags still resolve through the strongest pass.
Repository candidates now include both bound and unbound Task sets.
Repository matching compares canonical git common directories.
Both adapters discard duplicate IDs across repositories, and cursor keys still collide on identical project names and IDs.
Unknown repository identities yield no attribution or user-facing message.
Repository attribution concatenates every answering kind; two-kind tests assert this.
Repository identity is captured at launch; a counting git test checks five rebuilds.
Status uses empty pane facts; tests check no lifting or repository-attribution git calls.
Lifting only moves admitted rows, preserving preset narrowing.
Arrived Maps remain visible under active and enter repository attribution, so non-live Maps still lift.
Repository answers merge Task sets before Maps, with integration coverage.
Map session attribution returns before the weaker repository pass.
Routines implement no locality attribution; a comment explicitly explains the asymmetry.

scores.rationale: Clear implementation and broad regression coverage, but repository collisions and non-live Map lifting violate acceptance and lack targeted tests.
